I have been searching for a lost legendary weapon, and I have recorded all my findings from this journey in this scroll. It is said that to forge that forgotten blade, one must first obtain a dragon egg and use its contained power to craft that weapon. However, after I obtained the dragon egg, how to "craft" it became a dilemma - should the dragon egg be melted into an ingot? Or does it require some profound magical ritual? But one day, after accidentally breaking the dragon egg, I glimpsed the secret within: inside, like an amethyst geode, it was densely filled with a purple crystal. I grasped those crystals tightly, my mind already fantasizing about the discoveries yet to come, and named this material - §5"Dragon Crystal"§r.
As a blacksmith, I clearly know that almost all advanced forging requires a smithing template. After numerous attempts, I concluded that the original Netherite upgrade template was not applicable, so I began trying to use materials from the End to create a new upgrade template, and finally obtained the §5Dragon Crystal Upgrade Template§r. Afterward, I realized that the original smithing table certainly wouldn't work either, so I tried using Dragon Crystals and various materials to enhance the smithing table. After countless attempts, I obtained the foundation of everything, the §5Dragon Crystal Smithing Table§r that fascinates all blacksmiths.
Finally, the exciting moment has arrived. I placed the Dragon Crystal Upgrade Template, Netherite Sword, and Dragon Crystal in sequence on the Smithing Table. As the hammer fell, the surface of the Netherite Sword was covered with Dragon Crystal, and faint thunder appeared around the entire weapon. I casually swung it, and just as the legends described, a diamond flew from the blade and summoned a bolt of lightning where it landed. At last, the legendary weapon long forgotten by the world shall reveal itself once again. I named this nascent weapon §5"Dragon Crystal Sword"§r. Afterward, I placed the Dragon Crystal Sword on the Dragon Crystal Smithing Table, following the same sequence—Dragon Crystal Upgrade Template, Dragon Crystal Sword, and Dragon Crystal—and forged it again, successfully obtaining a higher-level Dragon Crystal Sword. Through countless repeated forgings, I finally sensed this weapon was about to transcend into a new realm. The draconic aura on the blade grew restless and violent, as if craving souls to nourish itself. I used the Dragon Soul Lantern as the upgrade material. In an instant, the sword's appearance underwent a dramatic transformation. Now this §5"Dragon Sword"§r not only enhances the original lightning-summoning power but also possesses the ability to command sword wraiths like the Dragon Soul Lantern.
I vaguely recall that in the legends, Dragon Crystals could not only forge weapons but also be used to craft armor. So I followed the same pattern, placing the Dragon Crystal Upgrade Template, Netherite armor, and Dragon Crystal on the Smithing Table. As expected, the Dragon Crystal adhered perfectly to the surface of the Netherite armor. I excitedly donned this §5"Dragon Crystal Armor"§r, feeling the draconic power providing comprehensive enhancements to my body. Suddenly, a strange sensation enveloped me, as if something was trying to isolate me from the world. Curious, I tested this armor and discovered something shocking: no matter what damage I took, that isolating sensation would weaken slightly, then completely nullify the damage! Moreover, as I continuously upgraded the Dragon Crystal Armor at the Dragon Crystal Smithing Table, that strange isolating sensation grew stronger when worn.
During my continuous research on Dragon Crystal, I discovered, beyond its legendary weapon performance and lightning-summoning abilities, a chilling new property—it seems Dragon Crystals possess an extraordinary attraction to souls. As a blacksmith, I knew nothing of souls or magic, so I entrusted a mage friend to help research this frightening characteristic. After a year passed, he sent me not only a letter, but also a crystalline stone and a purple-black lantern. After reading his letter, I grew even more fearful: "By combining magically-attuned materials with Dragon Crystal, I created this §5Dragon Crystal Soul Stone§r. I found this soul stone possesses extraordinary soul-attracting properties, but the souls of the dead do not linger around it for long, as if they've lost their way to reach it. So I thought to borrow the symbolism of 'lantern' and crafted the §5Dragon Soul Lantern§r from Dragon Crystal and a lantern to guide souls back to the soul stone. I discovered that regardless of what they were in life, all souls depend equally on the Dragon Crystal Soul Stone after death, eagerly trying to squeeze into it. You said Dragon Crystals come from decomposed dragon eggs—could this soul stone be similar to an 'egg' in some sense, symbolizing a path to rebirth? I also found that the Dragon Soul Lantern can temporarily block the connection between souls and their corresponding soul stones, releasing the soul once more! Moreover, even creatures §ckilled§r by me, after their souls are attracted to the soul stone and summoned again through the Dragon Soul Lantern, will fight for me. You must be careful—this power doesn't match previous descriptions of Dragon Crystals. I suspect this inconsistency will bring great danger. You'd better stop going to the End for more Dragon Crystals." My mage friend's letter shook me greatly. I never imagined Dragon Crystals could have such uses and dangers. However, I ultimately decided to return to the End once more. I yearned to forge the final form of that legendary weapon. The world has forgotten its appearance—if I could reforge it, I would have no regrets as a blacksmith. ...I heard a heartbeat. When I returned to the End again, that sound seemed to come from beneath the End's void. I gazed into that all-consuming nothingness, and I felt an urge to jump down... I finally regained my senses and fled back to the village, never daring to return to the End again. What a pity—I can no longer complete that ultimate weapon. If someone obtains my scroll, then go explore the End, and use everything I discovered and failed to discover as materials to forge your ultimate end of all things.
§6Coming Soon — Addon Dimension Adventure Mod "The Last Sword: Under Void"

The mage has vanished, and even the village where he lived has been destroyed by unknown forces. The village didn't look like it was raided by Pillagers, as not a single possession had been moved—only the devastation of lives lost remained. I only found some fragments of banners that seemed to symbolize dragons. Recently in my dreams, I heard that heartbeat again. Unlike the steady, regular rhythm before, the heartbeat gradually began to accelerate, growing louder and louder. Are they about to find me?! I ultimately chose to leave my family, instructing them to preserve this scroll and one day, when they meet someone with great obsession with forging and who can be trusted, to reveal this secret to the world once more. §k012345§rBeneath the Void§k678901§rFalling Star§k234567§rDragonslayer§k890123§r §5When the broken sword is reforged, all things shall meet their end.§r

item_tooltip_lore.the_last_sword.ancient: Legend says these devices were crafted by a lost civilization under the End's void, their exact construction remains undeciphered.
item_tooltip_lore.the_last_sword.dimensi: The boots every adventurer dreams of. Legend says when its wearer faces mortal peril, it will guide them away from all danger.
item_tooltip_lore.the_last_sword.dragon_: A living armor designed for multiversal exploration, ensuring its wearer can easily handle various dangerous situations across the cosmos. It can activate the built-in Void Phase Device during flight, separating its wearer from the world into a pocket universe to avoid attacks.
Obtained from dragon eggs, it contains a small amount of dragon power.
Imbued with the power of dragons on its outer shell, a mighty armor rarely found in the mortal realm.
Those who wish to wear this crown must have the qualities of a king, or disaster will befall them.
The Perfect Fusion of Magic and Technology
A gift for the lucky ones, but every gift comes with a price.
An ancient ring, said to be a token of love given by a princess to her knight. The blessing to protect the bearer still remains.
This is the object of a mortal blacksmith's dreams and desires.
There's a hidden hint of thunder within.
This power can help common items become uncommon.
At the final moment of life, guide their souls into the Soul Stone
The dragon roars through the skies, and thunder echoes across the world.
item_tooltip_lore.the_last_sword.extreme: A belt that helps its wearer survive in high-risk environments. The exact technology behind it remains unknown.
item_tooltip_lore.the_last_sword.the_giv: A glove wrapped in magical thorns; when striking enemies, it pierces the wearer as well. What torment did one endure to forge this?
item_tooltip_lore.the_last_sword.the_las: A scroll written at an unknown time, said to record how to forge the forgotten legendary sword
All things come to an end.
item_tooltip_lore.the_last_sword.wings_t: Wings of the World Devourer. The bearer has earned the right to become King of the End.

talk.lost_wraith.activation: Thank you... Now, let us begin. Only the honor of fighting to the death can grant me true peace!
talk.lost_wraith.death: Finally, I am free! The Ender Dragon's curse can no longer bind me! I will fulfill our pact. Take my soul stone and place it in an item with summoning functionality. When you face formidable foes, you can summon me to fight for you!
talk.lost_wraith.init_2: In endless ages, I have almost forgotten where I came from.
talk.lost_wraith.init_3: I was once an adventurer like you, but I became obsessed with power, too arrogant, and the Ender Dragon cast me into the void below. I cannot live, yet cannot die.
talk.lost_wraith.init_4: I am not undead; the power of the End keeps me between the boundaries of life and death.
talk.lost_wraith.init_5: The river of time should have erased everything I cherished, but if you completely free me from the torment of flesh, I will pledge loyalty to you and fight for you.
talk.lost_wraith.init_7: Items containing the Ender Dragon's power can free me, then please grant me peace.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.ancient_r: To think bones can move on their own—how rare.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.ender_gua: What are you guarding? Even yourself will be forgotten.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.ignis: What a fearsome flame! Warrior, you deserve my full strength in battle!
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.maledictu: You seem to share something in common with me. Perhaps I should grant you liberation.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.netherite: If you were to be released into the Overworld, it would only bring the smoke of war.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.scylla: How does it feel to live in the storms of the sky? I don't like it—it's too lonely.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.spawn_1: May I ask, are you my master?
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.spawn_2: I will fight for you until this body fades away.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.spawn_3: Finally, I can see the light of day once again.
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.the_harbi: A creation of an ancient civilization? Why does it bear the visage of the Wither?
talk.the_last_end_sword_wraith.the_levia: Predators from another dimension are not welcome here!
